Definition: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to deceive, lie, fail, grow lean, be disappointing, be untrue, be insufficient, be found liars, belie, deny, dissemble, deal falsely; 1a) (Qal) to become lean; 1b) (Niphal) to cringe, feign obedience; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to deceive, deny falsely; 1c2) to act deceptively; 1c3) to cringe; 1c4) to disappoint, fail; 1d) (Hithpael) to cringe, feign obedience
